integrity: Exact finite-state identity and independent brute-force histograms validated using the included code; asymptotic claims rely on the stated primitive Perron transfer and cycle variance proof, not on finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Only open 4-by-N rectangle tilings by two domino orientations and 3-by-3 squares are treated. The full planar entropy, other strip heights and nonuniform tiling measures are not settled. The independent audit and complete historical-priority check remain unperformed.
title: Exact pressure and Gaussian square counts on the first interacting domino–square strip
